messages:
sanjay: Borealis replied — they're greenlighted for an early access preview of their new tensor accelerator. NDA ok but asked for a light bench + telemetry integration. proposing a 4-week EAP window. any concerns?
marie: send NDA to legal, please. last HW NDA had an odd IP carveout; we'll need to watch that. looping legal now.
olivia: i can own telemetry. want to keep it minimal: perf CSV export + a tiny agent that POSTs anonymized metrics to our telemetry endpoint. no raw inputs retained.
adam: marketplace note: if we intend a joint listing later, we'll need an AMI/container spec and a marketplace-ready artifact. make that a stretch goal, not a blocker.
sanjay: Borealis' requested metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, model load/boot time, KV cache memory profile, and crash dumps. they want a sync this week after NDA.
marie: legal aims to have the NDA draft by EOD to sign early next week. i'm adding a 45-day press embargo after bench completion — okay?
olivia: 45 days is fine. telemetry schema: tokens_per_sec, p50_latency, p95_latency, p99_latency, kv_cache_bytes, gpu_util_pct, oom_count, sampled_input_hash. will HMAC the payload.
sanjay: sharing a minimal perf command for them to run in CI:
```
# synthetic perf run
python perf_run.py --model r-instruct-3b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 100 --report csv --kv-probe
```
please ensure --kv-probe enabled.
adam: internal marketplace checklist: icon, short/long description, pricing bands, telemetry privacy blurb, and contact for joint marketing. sara from marketing should be looped.
partner_ops_bot: ACTION: created EAP ticket #EAP-782 (assignee: sanjay). Sync deadline in 72 hours.
marie: also flag SI integration: Borealis wants Whitecap Systems to run a joint validation. need a contact intro and two-week runway for their validation.
olivia: proposed telemetry transport: HTTPS POST to https://telemetry.redwood.ai/eap with X-EAP-HMAC header. i'll draft schema and sample payload by Tues.
sanjay: proposed timeline: week0 NDA + env exchange; week1 bench + telemetry run; week2 infra fixes + SI prep; week3 SI joint test; week4 analysis + signoff. joint announcement earliest week6.
adam: marketing holds announcement until bench results and a signed coop MOU.
marie: legal wants a rollback clause in the MOU for regressions that impact customers.
olivia: i'll also create a 50-prompt eval set focusing on long-context regens to detect quality regressions.
sanjay: owners: NDA (marie) by Fri EOD; telemetry schema (olivia) by Tue; marketplace spec (adam) by next Wed; runbook & bench scripts (sanjay) by Tue; SI intro (marie) by Mon.
adam: added marketing + legal to ticket.
marie: NDA draft posted to the ticket when ready. signing off today.
partner_ops_bot: REMINDER: scheduled sync in 72 hours.
